english.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for something extremely bad or awful.
Use this as the everyday choice for something that is disappointingly poor or inadequate.
Use this for an awful or terrible result, performance, or situation when the sense is simply that it is very bad.
Use this for something awful, lousy, or very bad rather than fear-inducing.

examples.english: The food at this restaurant is really appalling.
examples.traditional: 呢間餐廳啲嘢食真係差勁。
